As we prepare to finalize the graduation ceremony plan, I need each of you to report any information that must be reflected in the plan before I can approve it. The current draft proposes one ceremony on June 12 at the civic auditorium, three guest tickets per graduate, diploma release for all graduating seniors, English-only announcements, and general seating by homeroom. Please share anything I need to know so we can make sure the plan is complete and correct.
